title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: SFTIs assigned to NSAWC will serving as Subject Matter Experts (SME) and will perform lecture and courseware review and integration functions.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: The goal is to provide one SFTI to each Fighter Attack Squadron (VFA) F/A-18A/C/E, two (one pilot, one Radar Intercept Officer (RIO)) to each Fighter Squadron (VF), and two (one pilot, one Weapons Sensor Officer (WSO)) to each VFA F/A-18F squadron.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: In most instances, prior to an SFTI serving as a squadron Training Officer, he or she will serve a shore tour assignment as an NSAWC instructor, TWWS instructor, Fleet Replacement Squadron (FRS) instructor or weapons test instructor.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: In addition to SFTS- related training, the Naval Strike and Air Warfare Center is responsible for follow-on training of SFTIs.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: SFTP is comprised of three components called “pillars”: • Strike Fighter Tactics Instructor (SFTI) • Strike Fighter Weapons and Tactics (SFWT) Syllabus • Strike Fighter Training System (SFTS) The goal of the SFTP is to increase aircrew readiness and combat capabilities while achieving training economies and efficiencies.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: The SFTI course objective is to graduate officers who are fully qualified to execute the Strike Fighter Weapons and Tactics (SFWT) program and provide internal training and external evaluation at the fleet squadron level.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: The syllabus objective is to maximize tactical proficiency and increase combat effectiveness.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: A five-tiered (Levels I-V) approach in designation of aircrew will be employed.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: (SFTI Designation) The SFWT syllabus and associated qualification and currency guidance will be promulgated via a joint Type Wing instruction.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: NMCI will periodically update the hardware, software, and networks to keep up with current technology.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: SFTS computers will be used by the Type Wing Weapons School (TWWS) and fleet aircrew to deliver training, deliver reference material, schedule squadron and unit events, generate reports of aircrew qualification status, and track aircrew certification and training via ETJs.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: The Training Management System (TMS) portion of SFTS is called Strike Fighter On Line (SFOL), which will become Air Combat On Line (ACOL) in ACTC.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: Provides a full spectrum management from ground-based training through the briefing for a training event, the event, and post-event debriefing process, including tools for reviewing aircrew progress and remediation. • Will be able to assess training system effectiveness, and provide tools for measuring and reporting squadron readiness via Sierra Hotel Aviation Readiness Program (SHARP). • Managing, measuring, and reporting all aircrew qualifications, proficiency, and currency, ensuring that access to squadron level data is controlled so that all data is available at the squadron level, but access by others is limited.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: The Information Management System’s purpose is to: • Disseminate data by generating aircrew qualification reports. • Track aircrew certification and training. • Provide access to reference materials.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: Each server will have two sets of duplicate hardware that will meet the requirements of IT21 and NMCI specifications at the time of delivery.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: Introduction of SFTIs to the fleet began in third quarter Fiscal Year (FY) 95 and training of new SFTIs will continue indefinitely.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: The academic portion of the SFWT syllabus will be introduced to the fleet in second quarter FY02.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: Revision and Upgrades to the first delivered syllabi will begin at that time.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: SFTP will serve as the benchmark or prototype program for all other programs developed for the ACTC.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: This infrastructure is necessary if realistic F/A-18 and F-14 mission planning and training functions are to be achieved.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: In second quarter FY02, the TYCOMs and NSAWC will assume operation and support of the program.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: The ESC is responsible for SFTP oversight, providing executive level management and requirements/policy decision making for major SFTP issues.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: The SFTIs at NSAWC, SFWSL, SFWSP, and fleet squadrons will have the ability to deliver training, schedule squadron and/or unit events, generate aircrew qualification reports, and track aircrew certification and training 24 hours a day, whether ashore or afloat.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: Government Service or contractor personnel will be located at all Strike Fighter locations to load courseware, assist SFTIs with account maintenance security, and monitor the overall status of the local server.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: The Software Database Administrator will monitor the overall status of all SFTS servers, including those afloat and at forward-deployed stations, and perform preventive and corrective maintenance.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: CVs and CVNs afloat will have an Information Technology Specialist (IT) that should be familiar with the SOP provided during the installation.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: An adequately trained IT with experience or training in System Administration skills for NT, IIS, and database administration will be able to handle most if not all discrepancies with the SFTS server.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: Preventive maintenance actions will consist of scheduled system backups, periodic defragmentation of disk drives, and general cleaning.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: Corrective maintenance will consist of replacing failed LRUs and rebuilding corrupted files. b.

text: Depot level repair of SFTS will be conducted by NMCI or Automated Information Specialist personnel. d.

text: BAH will provide the interim maintenance for the SFTS hardware and associated SFOL during the warranty period (approximately two years), ending in fourth quarter FY02. e.

text: Components will be repaired or replaced as they fail.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: The SFTIs will conduct training, schedule squadron and unit events, generate aircrew qualification status reports, and track aircrew certification and training.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: Additionally, SFTIs at NSAWC will continually monitor training materials for accuracy and currency.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: I-12 NSAWC is responsible for training SFTIs.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: The following are requirements to attend the SFTI courses: • Endorsement by Commanding Officer, Air Wing Commander, or Type Wing Commander with emphasis on leadership, tactical ability, aviation skills, and instructing capability. • Selection by Type Wing selection board, which will convene prior to class convening dates. • Acknowledging acceptance to the SFTI course requires a 24-month active duty sea duty obligation after completion of a shore duty assignment at NSAWC, TWWS, FRS, or Air Test Squadron and after completion of the SFTI course.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: SFTIs serve as the cornerstone of the SFWT program and are responsible for conducting training, generating aircrew qualification reports, and tracking aircrew certification and training at their sites.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: Simulator and flight events will be representative of those listed in the community Training and Readiness Matrix (T&RM), and are not additional events beyond those listed in the T&RM.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: The SFWT syllabus also has external standardization evaluation within a five-tiered approach. • Level I .......FRS Complete • Level II......Combat Wingman • Level III.....Combat Section Lead • Level IV.....Combat Division Lead • Level V......SFTI Designation SFTIs will maintain training records for all aircrew members at their respective squadrons on SFTS.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: These records are kept as part of the SFOL database and will be used to track the following information: • Qualification • Academic Completions • Open and Closed Book Examinations • Trainer and Flight Event Grade Sheets • Certifications • Unsatisfactory Events • External Standard Evaluations • Level 2, 3, and 4 Wing Recommendations

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE STRIKE FIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM
text: SFTIs will use the SFTS program at each site to manage the SFTP and ensure the development of highly trained aircrews. a.
